data: What is the Sarc. F-Measure value for the orange line at 400 posts/class?

The orange line represents the RQ subcorpus. At approximately 400 posts/class on the x-axis, the orange line intersects with the y-axis around 0.67. Therefore, the Sarc. F-Measure value for the orange line at 400 posts/class is approximately 0.67.
